title: Real God: The Rapture
description: The rapture is real. In Minecraft, anyway.
body:
Upset the rapture never happened? Experience it in Minecraft instead! Or just terrify your friends by watching them get raptured, that's fine too.

The rapture takes you straight up to heaven, and if you want to go back to your regular Minecraft life you're going to have to get past Jesus himself. Good luck!
